```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(LNCDR)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mgcv)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyr)
library(gratia)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggeffects)
library(marginaleffects)
library(extrafont)
extrafont::loadfonts()
library(eegkit)
library(ggseg)
library(ggsegGlasser)
library(conflicted)
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
library(ggnewscale)

outliers <- function(x) {
  (abs(x - mean(x, na.rm= T)) > (sd(x, na.rm= T) * 1.5))
}
naoutlier <- function(x) ifelse(outliers(x), NA, x)

glasser_lobes <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/glasser_lobes.csv')

dramatic_palette <- c(
  "#001a08",  # near-black green
  "#012b0d",  # original dark forest
  "#014421",  # deep emerald
  "#27763d",  # original medium green
  "#4fa36a",  # brighter transition
  "#90b8a6",  # original sage
  "#d8efe2"  # pale mint
)

```

## Average delay and fix to represent a overall "task state"
```{r}

avgACW_allEpochs <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/glasser/allSubjects_glasserRegions_beamforming_allEpochs_allregions.csv') %>% mutate(ageGroup = cut(age, c(0,18,Inf), labels = c('Adol','Adults')))


task = avgACW_allEpochs  %>% dplyr::filter(epoch == 'Delays' | epoch == 'Fix')

task_avg <- task %>%
  group_by(lunaid, orig_parcelname, age, sex, vdate, visitno, lobe) %>%
  summarize(
    ACW_50 = mean(ACW_50, na.rm = TRUE),
    age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mutate(ageGroup = cut(age, c(0,18,Inf), labels = c('Adol','Adults')))




# task state ACW decreases across age 

lunaize(ggplot(data = task_avg, aes(x = age, y = ACW_50, color=lobe))) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group=1), method=mgcv::"gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 3, fx = T), alpha=0.3, linewidth = 1.5)+ facet_wrap(~lobe)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#012b0d", "#90b8a6", "#27763d", "#d8efe2")) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .2), 
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .2),
    strip.background = element_rect('white'))




rest = avgACW_allEpochs  %>% dplyr::filter(epoch == 'Rest')
task_avg$epoch <- 'Task'

task_rest <- rbind(rest, task_avg)

task_rest <- task_rest %>% group_by(lunaid, lobe, epoch) %>%
  mutate(across(c("ACW_50"), naoutlier))

write.csv(task_rest, file = '/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/glasser/allSubjects_glasserRegions_beamforming_taskRest_allregions_2.csv', row.names = F)
```


```{r}
task_rest <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/glasser/allSubjects_glasserRegions_beamforming_taskRest_allregions_2.csv')
task_rest$sex <- as.factor(task_rest$sex)

task_rest$epoch <- factor(task_rest$epoch, ordered=T)


glasser_rois <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/glasser360_regionlist.csv') %>%
  mutate(roi = gsub('_ROI', '', orig_parcelname)) %>%
  mutate(roi = gsub('L_', 'Left_', roi)) %>%
  mutate(roi = gsub('R_', 'Right_', roi))


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Average adol and adults 
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
 task_rest_avg <- task_rest %>%
    group_by(ageGroup, orig_parcelname, epoch) %>%
    summarize(
      ACW_50 = mean(ACW_50, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

# run when remote ------------------------------------------------------------
glasser <- glasser()
glasser$data$hemi <- factor(glasser$data$hemi, levels = c('right','left'))
glasser$data$side <- factor(glasser$data$side, levels = c('medial','lateral'))
#  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


task_rest_avg <- task_rest_avg %>% merge(., glasser_rois, by = 'orig_parcelname', all=T)

# run when remote ------------------------------------------------------------
 task_rest_avg <- task_rest_avg %>% mutate(label = paste0(label, "_ROI"))
#  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot() +
  theme_void() +
  geom_brain(
    data = task_rest_avg %>% filter(epoch == 'Rest' & ageGroup == 'Adol'),
    atlas = glasser,
    side = "lateral",
    aes(fill = ACW_50)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours =  dramatic_palette) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(filename = "/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/Figures/Figure1/INT_rest_adol_brain.pdf", device = "pdf", dpi = 500, width = 18, height = 5)
```

# compare to sa axis
```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# compare to SA axis
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
library(cifti)

glasser.snr.exclude <- read.csv("/Volumes/Hera/Projects/corticalmyelin_development/Maps/SNR/glasser_SNR_exclusion.csv")

glasser.plotting <- glasser_rois
glasser.plotting$cortex <- "cortex"
glasser.plotting$cortex[glasser.plotting$orig_parcelname %in% glasser.snr.exclude$orig_parcelname] <- "exclude"
glasser.plotting <- glasser.plotting %>% select(label, cortex)
glasser.plotting <- rbind(glasser.plotting, data.frame(label = "rh_???", cortex = "exclude"))
glasser.plotting <- rbind(glasser.plotting, data.frame(label = "lh_???", cortex = "exclude"))
glasser.plotting <- glasser.plotting %>% filter(label != "lh_L_10pp")


S.A.axis.cifti <- read_cifti("/Volumes/Hera/Projects/corticalmyelin_development/Maps/S-A_ArchetypalAxis/FSLRVertex/SensorimotorAssociation_Axis_parcellated/SensorimotorAssociation.Axis.Glasser360.pscalar.nii") #S-A_ArchetypalAxis repo
S.A.axis <- data.frame(SA.axis = rank(S.A.axis.cifti$data), orig_parcelname = names(S.A.axis.cifti$Parcel))
S.A.axis <- merge(S.A.axis, glasser_rois, by = "orig_parcelname")

# run when remote ------------------------------------------------------------
S.A.axis <- S.A.axis %>% mutate(label = paste0(label, "_ROI"))
#  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


ggplot() + 
  geom_brain(data = S.A.axis, atlas = glasser, 
             side = "lateral", 
             mapping = aes(fill = SA.axis), 
             colour=I("gray20"), size=I(.08)) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = dramatic_palette, na.value = 'white') + 
    new_scale_fill() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  geom_brain(data = glasser.plotting, atlas = glasser, side = "lateral", mapping = aes(fill = cortex),  colour=I(alpha("gray50", 0)), size=I(0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("white", 0), "gray75")) 


SA_adol <- merge(task_rest_avg %>% filter(ageGroup == 'Adol'), S.A.axis, by = 'orig_parcelname')
SA_adult <- merge(task_rest_avg %>% filter(ageGroup == 'Adults'), S.A.axis, by = 'orig_parcelname')

SA_all <- merge(task_rest_avg, S.A.axis, by = 'orig_parcelname')



lunaize(ggplot(data = SA_all, aes(x = SA.axis, y = ACW_50, color=ageGroup))) + geom_point(alpha= 0.3)+
  geom_smooth(aes(group=ageGroup), method='lm', alpha=0.3, linewidth = 1.5)+
scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
  "Rest" = "dashed",
  "Task" = "solid"
)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#012b0d", "#90b8a6")) +  # Custom line colors
  facet_wrap(~epoch) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = 'right',
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),  # Removed vectorized input here
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),  # Removed vectorized input here
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),  # Removed vectorized input here
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.2), 
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.2), 
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0)) + 
  xlab("Sensorimotor-Association Axis") +
  ylab("ACW (s)")


ggsave(filename = "/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/Figures/Figure1/SAaxis_adolAdults_restTask.pdf", device = "pdf", dpi = 500, width = 10, height = 5)



SA_all %>%
  filter(epoch == "Task", ageGroup == "Adol") %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(SA.axis, ACW_50, use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(SA.axis, ACW_50)$p.value
  )


SA_all %>%
  filter(epoch == "Task") %>% filter(ageGroup == "Adults") %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(SA.axis, ACW_50, use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(SA.axis, ACW_50)$p.value
  )


SA_all %>%
  filter(epoch == "Rest", ageGroup == "Adol") %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(SA.axis, ACW_50, use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(SA.axis, ACW_50)$p.value
  )


SA_all %>%
  filter(epoch == "Rest") %>% filter(ageGroup == "Adults") %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(SA.axis, ACW_50, use = "complete.obs"),
    p = cor.test(SA.axis, ACW_50)$p.value
  )
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# DLPFC
# ----------------------------------

lunaize(ggplot(data = task_rest %>% filter(orig_parcelname == 'R_46_ROI' | orig_parcelname == 'L_46_ROI'), aes(x = age, y = ACW_50, linetype=epoch, color = "#001a08"))) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group=interaction(epoch)), method=mgcv::"gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 3, fx = T), alpha=0.3, linewidth = 1.5) + geom_point(aes(shape=epoch), alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(group= interaction(lunaid, epoch)), alpha = 0.2, linewidth=0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#001a08")) + 
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
  "Rest" = "dashed",
  "Task" = "solid")) +
  (theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "#001a08"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .2), 
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .2),
    strip.background = element_rect('white'),
     panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + 
  ggtitle('Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex (45)') +
  xlab("Age") +
  ylab("ACW (s)") + facet_wrap(~sex)

ggsave(filename = "/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/Figures/Figure1/dlpfc.pdf", device = "pdf", dpi = 500, width = 10, height = 10)


## main effect
gam.model <-  mgcv::gamm(ACW_50 ~ s(age, k = 3) + sex + epoch, data = task_rest %>% filter(orig_parcelname == 'R_46_ROI' | orig_parcelname == 'L_46_ROI'), random=list(lunaid=~1))
summary(gam.model$gam)
p.adjust(4.19e-06, method = "BH", n = 360)

## task interaction
gam.model <-  mgcv::gamm(ACW_50 ~ s(age, k = 3) + s(age, k = 3, by=epoch) + sex + epoch, data = task_rest %>% filter(orig_parcelname == 'R_46_ROI' | orig_parcelname == 'L_46_ROI'), random=list(lunaid=~1))
summary(gam.model$gam)
```

# Age of maturation - all regions
```{r}

####  ACW Rate of maturation ----

epochs <- unique(task_rest$epoch)
regions <- unique(task_rest$orig_parcelname)
task_rest$lunaid <- as.factor(task_rest$lunaid)
task_rest$epoch <- as.factor(task_rest$epoch)

# Initialize lists to store results
gamstats_list <- list()
gamderivatives_list <- list()
gammodel_list <- list()
# Loop through each combination of epoch and region
for (task in epochs) {
  for (loc in regions) {
    
    # Apply the growthrate function for each combination
    allstats <- growthrate(task_rest_centered %>% dplyr::filter(epoch == task & orig_parcelname == loc), 'ACW_50', 'age', loc)
    
    # Create a data frame of stats and add epoch  info
    gamstats <- allstats$gam.statistics %>% 
      mutate(epoch = task) %>%
      mutate(orig_parcelname = loc)
    
    # Create a data frame of derivatives and add epoch info
    gamderivatives <- allstats$gam.derivatives %>% 
      mutate(epoch = task) %>%
      mutate(orig_parcelname = loc)
    
    gamsmoothestimates <- allstats$gam.smoothestimates %>% 
      mutate(epoch = task) %>%
      mutate(orig_parcelname = loc)
    
    gamfittedValues <- allstats$gam.fittedvalues %>% 
      mutate(epoch = task) %>%
      mutate(orig_parcelname = loc)
    
    # Store results
    gamstats_glasser_list[[paste(task,loc, sep = "_")]] <- gamstats
    gamderivatives_glasser_list[[paste(task, loc, sep = "_")]] <- gamderivatives
    gamsmoothestimates_glasser_list[[paste(task,loc, sep = "_")]] <- gamsmoothestimates
    gamfittedValues_glasser_list[[paste(task,loc, sep = "_")]] <- gamfittedValues
    
    
  }
}

saveRDS(gamstats_glasser_list, file = "gamstats_list_allregions_notmeancentered.rds")
saveRDS(gamderivatives_glasser_list, file = "gamderivatives_list_allregions_notmeancentered.rds")
saveRDS(gamsmoothestimates_glasser_list, file = "gamsmoothestimates_list_allregions_notmeancentered.rds")
saveRDS(gamfittedValues_glasser_list, file = "gamfittedValues_list_allregions_notmeancentered.rds")
```

# Epoch Interactiuon 
```{r}

####  ACW Rate of maturation ----

regions <- unique(task_rest$orig_parcelname)
task_rest$lunaid <- as.factor(task_rest$lunaid)
task_rest$epoch <- as.factor(task_rest$epoch)

task_rest$epoch <- factor(
  task_rest$epoch,
  levels = c("Rest", "Task"),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Initialize lists to store results
interaction_stats_list <- list()

# Loop through each combination of epoch and region
for (loc in regions) {
  
  interaction.model <- gam(ACW_50 ~ s(age, k = 4, fx = F)  + s(age, by = epoch, k = 3) + s(lunaid, bs="re") + epoch, method = c("REML"),  data = task_rest %>% filter(orig_parcelname == loc))
  
  results <- data.frame()
  
  
  # Get smooth-term statistics
  sm <- summary(interaction.model)$s.table
  
  # Pull the age-by-epoch term
  interaction_row <- sm[grep("age.*epoch", rownames(sm)), , drop = FALSE]
  
  results <- bind_rows(
    results,
    data.frame(
      orig_parcelname = loc,
      edf = interaction_row[1, "edf"],
      F = interaction_row[1, "F"],
      p = interaction_row[1, "p-value"]
    )
  )
  
  # Store results
  
  interaction_stats_list[[loc]]  <- results
}

saveRDS(interaction_stats_list, file = "gamstats_list_allregions_ageEpoch_interactions.rds")
```
